lines.en: label springtimesadness2:
scene nikivisitschinami1
: Okay, so, good news and bad news. The good news is that Niki is coming here to try and fix your sister.
lines.zh: : 好，那么，有个好消息和一个坏消息。好消息是，Niki 要来这里试着治好你姐姐。

lines.en: : What’s the bad news?
lines.zh: : 坏消息是什么？

lines.en: : That at 8:46 AM EDT on September 11, 2001, American Airlines Flight 11 struck World Trade Center Tower 1 during one of the worst terrorist attacks in modern history.
lines.zh: : 坏消息是，在美国东部时间 2001 年 9 月 11 日上午 8 点 46 分，美国航空 11 号航班撞上了世贸中心一号楼，那是现代史上最严重的恐怖袭击之一。

lines.en: : You’re right. That is bad news.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。那确实是坏消息。

lines.en: : But seeing as there’s nothing we can do about that now, we should probably focus on the task at hand.
lines.zh: : 不过既然我们现在对此无能为力，还是把注意力放在眼前的事情上吧。

lines.en: : At least the second tower is still there.
lines.zh: : 至少第二栋楼还在。

lines.en: : Chinami, I have more bad news.
lines.zh: : Chinami，我还有更多坏消息。

lines.en: : Oh no.
lines.zh: : 哦不。

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami2

: On a serious note, though, which isn’t meant to imply that what we were just discussing {i}isn’t{/i} serious, there’s a chance that this could backfire. And if that happens, I need you to promise me one thing.
lines.zh: : 说正经的——这并不代表我们刚才聊的那些{i}不正经{/i}——这件事有可能会适得其反。而如果真的那样，我需要你答应我一件事。

lines.en: : Of course. Chinami will do anything to help her Papa.
lines.zh: : 当然。Chinami 愿意做任何事来帮助她的 Papa。

lines.en: : I need you to destroy my laptop.
lines.zh: : 我需要你毁掉我的笔记本电脑。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Don’t ask questions. Just follow orders. That is your job as my surrogate daughter.
lines.zh: : 别问问题。服从命令就行。那是你作为我的代理女儿的职责。

lines.en: : Chinami agrees. But only because it’s very rare for Papa to acknowledge that Chinami is his surrogate daughter.
lines.zh: : Chinami 同意。不过只是因为 Papa 承认 Chinami 是他的代理女儿，这种时候实在太罕见了。

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami3
: But wait, what do you mean by “backfire?” Is Niki actually a bad person who might murder big sis Chika for also being in love with you?
lines.zh: : 可是等等，你说的「适得其反」是什么意思？Niki 其实是坏人吗？她会不会因为 Chika 姐姐也爱着你而把她杀掉？

lines.en: : No. But your sister is actually a bad person who might murder Niki for also being in love with me.
lines.zh: : 不会。但你的姐姐才是个坏人，她可能会因为 Niki 也爱着我而把 Niki 杀掉。

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami4
: Big sis Chika wouldn’t kill anybody! Chinami knows that for sure because it would have happened already!
lines.zh: : Chika 姐姐才不会杀任何人呢！Chinami 敢肯定，因为要是会的话，早就发生了！

lines.en: : Either way, we need to be prepared for the worst. So be ready to call Tsukasa if anything happens because I have no idea how to dispose of a body and she probably does.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我们得做好最坏的打算。所以一旦出事，随时准备好给 Tsukasa 打电话，因为我完全不知道怎么处理尸体，而她大概知道。

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami5
: Chinami thinks this would be so much easier if she could find an opportunity to take the knife away.
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得，要是她能找个机会把刀拿走，事情会容易得多。

lines.en: : It looks to me like you have a pretty good opportunity right now, not gonna lie.
lines.zh: : 老实说，我觉得你现在就是个相当不错的机会。

lines.en: : But she looks so content. Maybe the knife gives her comfort? And who is Chinami to take that away from her in her time of need?
lines.zh: : 可她看起来那么满足。也许那把刀能给她安慰？而 Chinami 又算什么，怎么能在这个时候把它从她手里夺走呢？

lines.en: : Sometimes, I think you only exist to sow further chaos and assist in the downfall of me as a person.
lines.zh: : 有时候我真觉得，你存在的意义就是播撒更多的混乱，并协助我作为一个人的彻底垮台。

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami6
: Chinami will not confirm or deny this allegation. She’ll just close her eyes and wait until the celebrity gets here.
lines.zh: : Chinami 既不会承认也不会否认这项指控。她只是闭上眼睛，等那位名人到来。

lines.en: : You don’t want to change your outfit anymore?
lines.zh: : 你不想再换套衣服了吗？

lines.en: : No. Chinami realized that Niki’s standards probably aren’t as high as Chinami expected since she apparently settled for you.
lines.zh: : 不想。Chinami 意识到 Niki 的品味大概没有她以为的那么高，毕竟她显然将就了你。

lines.en: : I suddenly hope that the body I wind up having to dispose of is yours.
lines.zh: : 我突然希望最后要处理的尸体是你的。

lines.en: : Be careful what you wish for, Papa. For one day, that will likely be true.
lines.zh: : 许愿要小心哦，Papa。因为总有一天，那大概会成真。

lines.en: scene black

{size=-2}After spending the next thirty minutes or so trying to snatch the knife out of Chika’s hands, I come to the realization that her apparent cat-like reflexes extend beyond awareness itself, making her much more intimidating out of nowhere.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}在接下来的三十来分钟里，我试图从 Chika 手里把刀抢下来，结果意识到她那明显属于猫科动物的反射神经已经超越了意识本身，这让她一下子变得格外吓人。{/size}

lines.en: This is a wonderful thing to discover just moments before introducing her to a girl she idolizes that also happens to have fellated me on a daily basis for an extended period of time.
lines.zh: 而这一点，恰好是在把她介绍给一个她奉为神明、又恰好曾经长期每天为我口交的女孩之前的几分钟里发现的，真是妙极了。

lines.en: Oh, look. There’s the blowjob now.
lines.zh: 哦，瞧。给我口交的那位来了。

lines.en: I mean girl.
lines.zh: 我是说，那个女孩。

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami7
: Less than twenty-four hours back together and you’re already abusing my status as the greatest woman to ever live. I truly despise you, Akira.
lines.zh: : 重新在一起还不到二十四小时，你就已经开始滥用我「史上最伟大女性」的身份了。我真是恨透你了，Akira。

lines.en: : You can despise me all you want later. Right now, what’s most important is harnessing the cuteness within you that you conceal from me daily and then dumping it all over a teenage girl.
lines.zh: : 你想恨我，以后有的是时间。现在最重要的是，把你天天藏着不让我看的那份可爱劲儿调动出来，然后一股脑儿倒在一个未成年女孩身上。

lines.en: : Mhm. And what do I get out of this exactly?
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。那我到底能得到什么？

lines.en: : You said it over the phone, didn’t you? Something about putting her in her place and dissuading her from further pursuing me.
lines.zh: : 你在电话里不是说了吗？说什么要让她认清自己的位置，打消她继续追我的念头。

lines.en: : {size=-2}I’ve since reevaluated my stance in realizing that no one in their right mind would ever pursue you and so attempting to dissuade her from whatever mental illness compels her to in the first place would simply not work.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}后来我重新评估了立场——我意识到，任何一个脑子正常的人都不会去追你，所以试图劝她摆脱那驱使着她的精神疾病，根本就行不通。{/size}

lines.en: : You’re probably right about that. I’m not sure what else I can give you, though.
lines.zh: : 这点你大概是对的。可我也不知道还能给你什么了。

lines.en: : I want my name carved beneath your eyelids so that every time you blink, you’ll be reminded of me.
lines.zh: : 我要你把我的名字刻在你的眼皮底下，这样你每次眨眼，都会想起我。

lines.en: : Who says I’m not already?
lines.zh: : 谁说我不是呢？

lines.en: : Me after watching you rail my sister so hard that-
lines.zh: : 在你把我妹妹干得那么狠、以至于我——

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami8
: Child!
lines.zh: : 有小孩在！

lines.en: : She’s pregnant?...
lines.zh: : 她怀孕了？……

lines.en: : Have you heard about what happened on September 11th?
lines.zh: : 你听说 9 月 11 号那天发生的事了吗？

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami9
: Akira, what are you teaching this girl? And also, {i}why{/i} are you teaching this girl? Is high school no longer disgusting enough for you, so you must now corrupt even younger girls instead?
lines.zh: : Akira，你到底在教这女孩什么？还有，你{i}为什么{/i}要教这女孩？高中已经不够恶心你了，所以你非得去腐蚀年纪更小的女孩？

lines.en: : Papa hasn’t corrupted me at all! He’s always very nice to Chinami.
lines.zh: : Papa 才没有腐蚀 Chinami 呢！他对 Chinami 一直都很好。

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami10
: Papa?
lines.zh: : Papa？

lines.en: : I knew I should have warned her not to call me that.
lines.zh: : 我就知道该提醒她别那么叫我。

lines.en: : Chinami calls Papa “Papa” because her real dad ran away and now he’s the only male figure in her life. You really think she’d choose this guy if she had other options?
lines.zh: : Chinami 之所以管 Papa 叫「Papa」，是因为她亲生爸爸跑掉了，而现在 Papa 是她生命中唯一的男性。你真以为，如果她有别的选择，她会挑这家伙吗？

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami11
: Wow, okay.
lines.zh: : 哇，行吧。

lines.en: : I like her already. Your name’s Chinami?
lines.zh: : 我已经喜欢上她了。你叫 Chinami？

lines.en: : Mhm! Chinami Chosokabe! My sister’s your biggest fan ever, but I like you too!
lines.zh: : 嗯！长宗我部 Chinami！我姐姐是你的头号粉丝，不过我也喜欢你！

lines.en: : We listen to your music all the time. We used to have a bunch of posters too, but then we stopped being super poor and moved here and now we don’t have as many. Will you fix her, please?
lines.zh: : 我们经常听你的歌。以前我们还有一大堆海报呢，不过后来我们不再那么穷了，搬到了这里，海报就没那么多了。请你把她治好，好吗？

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami12
: That’s her over there I’m guessing? With the knife in her hand that my childhood friend was supposed to remove but didn’t because he’s literally incapable of ever doing anything helpful or good?
lines.zh: : 我猜，就是那边那个吧？手里还拿着刀——我那位青梅竹马本来应该把刀拿走的，可他没有，因为他这个人根本就没做成过任何有用或有益的事？

lines.en: : Yup! That’s her. You’re safe, though. Big sis Chika would never do anything to harm her idol. Or anybody really. Unless they’re a Yakuza guy named Gary. She hates Yakuza guys named Gary.
lines.zh: : 没错！就是她。不过你很安全。Chika 姐姐绝对不会伤害她的偶像。或者任何人。除非是叫 Gary 的黑道。她特别讨厌叫 Gary 的黑道。

lines.en: : How specific. Let’s see if I can wake her up. You be a good girl and wait here, okay? I don’t want you nearby if she gets excited and starts waving kitchen utensils around.
lines.zh: : 真是具体。让我看看能不能把她唤醒。你乖乖在这儿等着，好吗？万一她一激动开始挥舞厨具，我可不想你在旁边。

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami13
: Okay! Thank you, big sis Niki! Welcome to the family! Please be nice to my first sister since you’re sister number three and she has seniority!
lines.zh: : 好的！谢谢你，Niki 姐姐！欢迎来到我们家！请对我大姐好一点，因为你是三号姐姐，而她资历更老！

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami14
: Niki’s super nice, Papa! I can’t believe you’ve been keeping her to yourself this entire time!
lines.zh: : Niki 人超好的，Papa！我真不敢相信你一直把她藏着不让我们见！

lines.en: : It’s not like I {i}wanted{/i} to. Your sister just worships her as some sort of god rather than a pop star.
lines.zh: : 我又不是{i}想{/i}藏。你姐姐只是把她当成某种神明来崇拜，而不是一个流行歌手。

lines.en: : That’s because I {i}am{/i} a god to a lot of these girls, Akira.
lines.zh: : 那是因为对这些女孩中的很多人来说，我{i}就是{/i}神啊，Akira。

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami15
: The impact an idol can have on a person isn’t something {i}normies{/i} could ever understand. Is it, Chika?
lines.zh: : 一个偶像能对一个人产生多大的影响，{i}凡人{/i}是永远理解不了的。对吧，Chika？

lines.en: : Is it true you’re my biggest fan? Do you have a favorite song? A favorite album, perhaps?
lines.zh: : 你真的是我的头号粉丝吗？有没有最喜欢的歌？或者最喜欢的专辑？

lines.en: : You know, come to think of it, I’m pretty sure my sister’s told me about you before. You two are in the light music club together, right? I hope she’s not annoying you {i}too{/i} much.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，我想起来了，我妹妹以前跟我提过你。你俩都在轻音部，对吧？希望她没{i}太{/i}烦你。

lines.en: : She can be a bit of a handful. Nothing like {i}your{/i} little sister over there, who seems like nothing short of an angel. And I’m sure you’re a great influence on her, so a lot of that is probably thanks to you.
lines.zh: : 她有时候是挺让人头疼的。可完全不像你那个妹妹，那边那个简直就是个小天使。而且我相信你对她的影响一定很好，所以这里面大概有很多是{i}你的{/i}功劳。

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami16
: Chinami is going to take this now.
lines.zh: : Chinami 现在要把这个拿走了。

lines.en: : Thank you, Chinami. And no thank you to Akira, who wasn’t even useful enough to prevent you from approaching the kitchen utensils I warned you about.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Chinami。而 Akira 就不用谢了，他甚至没本事阻止你靠近我警告过你要避开的那些厨具。

lines.en: : Chinami does what she wants and I have no authority over her. Trust me, I’ve tried.
lines.zh: : Chinami 想做什么就做什么，我对她没有任何权威。相信我，我试过了。

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami17
: So, have you ever thought about becoming an idol yourself? Because you certainly have the look for it. You’re {i}way{/i} cuter than I was at your age.
lines.zh: : 那么，你有没有想过自己当偶像？因为你确实有那个样子。你在我这个年纪的时候，可比我{i}可爱多了{/i}。

lines.en: : Perhaps you’d like to try on one of my stage outfits? I can bring one over sometime if you’re interested. And hey, maybe I could even give you your own private show afterwards? How does that sound?
lines.zh: : 也许你想试穿一下我的演出服？如果你有兴趣，我改天可以带一套过来。而且嘿，说不定之后我还能给你来一场专属的私人演出？听起来怎么样？

lines.en: : Wow. If that’s not working, she might actually just be broken for good.
lines.zh: : 哇。要是这样都没用，那她可能真的就彻底坏掉了。

lines.en: : What’s Chinami supposed to do if big sis Chika is broken for good?! She can’t stay like this! Chinami misses her already!
lines.zh: : 如果 Chika 姐姐真的坏掉了，Chinami 该怎么办？！她不能一直这样啊！Chinami 已经开始想她了！

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami18
: Are you upset by what you saw on Instagram, maybe? Because you’re not alone if that’s the case.
lines.zh: : 也许你是因为在 Instagram 上看到的东西而难过？如果是这样的话，你并不孤单。

lines.en: : But here’s the thing, Chika. It’s not personal at all. And I don’t want you or {i}any{/i} of my fans to see this is some sort of betrayal. Or even a permanent goodbye.
lines.zh: : 可是你要明白，Chika。这完全不是针对你。我也不希望你或者我的{i}任何{/i}一个粉丝把这看成某种背叛。甚至不是一次永久的告别。

lines.en: : I just need to do what makes me happy if I’m going to keep being my best self. And I can promise you that I will {i}never{/i} stop loving and believing in you. Okay?
lines.zh: : 我只是需要去做能让我快乐的事，这样我才能继续做最好的自己。而我可以向你保证，我{i}永远{/i}不会停止爱你、相信你。好吗？

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami19
: Yeah, Akira’s right. I think she’s just flat out broken.
lines.zh: : 是啊，Akira 说得对。我看她是彻底坏掉了。

lines.en: : Great. Now Chinami has {i}no{/i} blood-related family left. Could today get any worse?
lines.zh: : 太好了。现在 Chinami 一个血亲{i}都不剩{/i}了。今天还能更糟一点吗？

lines.en: : Maybe try touching her? Like...give her a hug or something?
lines.zh: : 也许试试碰碰她？比如……给她一个拥抱什么的？

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami20
: Who am I, you? I’m not going to touch some teenage girl without her consent. I don’t even do handshake events anymore.
lines.zh: : 你以为我是你吗？我可不会未经一个未成年女孩的同意就去碰她。我连握手会都不办了。

lines.en: : I mean, you probably don’t do {i}anything{/i} anymore after the stunt you pulled yesterday.
lines.zh: : 我是说，在你昨天闹出那一出之后，你大概{i}什么都{/i}办不成了。

lines.en: : You’re completely right. In fact, I’m supposed to be at the office getting yelled at right now. I just figured it wouldn’t hurt to do this first since my career is already in shambles.
lines.zh: : 你说得完全正确。事实上，我现在本该坐在办公室里挨骂。我只是觉得，反正我的事业已经一塌糊涂了，先做这件事也无妨。

lines.en: : Chinami gives you consent to hug her sister if that helps...
lines.zh: : Chinami 同意你抱她姐姐，如果那样有用的话……

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami21
: It doesn’t. But that’s a very kind gesture, Chinami. I’m sorry I couldn’t help more. But if your sister ever wakes up, maybe the three of us can do something fun together?
lines.zh: : 没用。不过这份心意很善良，Chinami。抱歉我没能帮上更多。可要是你姐姐哪天醒了，也许我们三个可以一起做点好玩的事？

lines.en: : I imagine I’ll have plenty of free time from now on, so just ask Akira over here to let me know. Okay?
lines.zh: : 我想从今往后我会有大把的空闲时间，所以只要跟这边这位 Akira 说一声，让他告诉我就行。好吗？

lines.en: : Okay, but...does this mean you’re not going to make music anymore? Because both Chinami {i}and{/i} big sis Chika will be really sad if that’s true.
lines.zh: : 好的，可是……这是不是意味着你以后不做音乐了？因为如果真是那样，Chinami {i}和{/i} Chika 姐姐都会非常难过的。

lines.en: : I’ll keep making music since that’s how I express myself. It just might sound a little different than what you guys are used to.
lines.zh: : 我会继续做音乐的，因为那是我表达自我的方式。只是听起来可能会和你们习惯的不太一样。

lines.en: : Any last requests from me before I get out of here?
lines.zh: : 在我离开之前，还有什么最后的要求要对我提吗？

lines.en: : Just one. If you start making new kinds of music, can you promise Chinami that it won’t sound like Sleep Token? Because she really just doesn’t get what anybody sees in them.
lines.zh: : 只有一个。如果你开始做新类型的音乐，能不能向 Chinami 保证，它不会听起来像 Sleep Token？因为她实在搞不懂那支乐队到底有什么好看的。

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami22
: Can we trade Ami for this one? She’s so much better.
lines.zh: : 我们能用 Ami 换这一个吗？她好太多了。

lines.en: : Most of them are, Niki. But Ami is the one I deserve.
lines.zh: : 她们大多数都比她好，Niki。可 Ami 是我应得的那个。

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami23
: That said, I should probably get going too. I’m trying to earn more points with the reinforcement I called in today and I feel like points are being actively subtracted every second I spend here.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，我大概也该走了。我正在努力从我今天叫来的援军身上多挣点分，而我感觉，我在这里每多待一秒，分数都在被疯狂地扣掉。

lines.en: : You would be correct in thinking that, yes.
lines.zh: : 你这么想是对的，没错。

lines.en: : Fine...Chinami will try figuring out new ways to fix big sis Chika on her own. It’s safer now that she doesn’t have the knife anymore.
lines.zh: : 好吧……那 Chinami 就自己想办法治好 Chika 姐姐吧。现在她没刀了，也安全些了。

lines.en: : Call me if you need me, okay? But literally {i}only{/i} if you need me because, again, trying to earn idol points.
lines.zh: : 需要我的话就给我打电话，好吗？但真的{i}只{/i}限需要的时候，因为再说一遍，我在努力挣偶像点数。

lines.en: : You’re going to need a lot of them if you don’t want to be put on a leash.
lines.zh: : 如果你不想被人套上狗链，你需要的点数可多着呢。

lines.en: : See what I mean? Chika’s not the only one in danger here.
lines.zh: : 懂我意思了吧？这里有危险的，可不只 Chika 一个。

lines.en: : Chinami understands...But thank you anyway.
lines.zh: : Chinami 明白……不过还是谢谢你。

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami24
: It was nice meeting you, Niki. You look even prettier in person. I’m sure big sis Chika would say the same thing if her brain still worked.
lines.zh: : 很高兴认识你，Niki。你本人看起来更漂亮。Chinami 敢肯定，如果 Chika 姐姐的脑子还管用，她也会这么说。

lines.en: : I’m sure she would too because I {i}am{/i} prettier in person.
lines.zh: : 我也敢肯定她会，因为我本人{i}确实{/i}更漂亮。

lines.en: scene black
: Now — come, Akira. If I’m going to sit around and get yelled at for the next few hours, I’m dragging you along with me on the off chance it makes my producers less abrasive.
lines.zh: : 那么——走吧，Akira。既然接下来几个小时我要坐在这儿挨骂，那我就把你一起拖上，说不定能让我的制作人说话别那么冲。

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami25
: {i}What? You mean I have to get yelled at too?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}什么？你是说我也得跟着挨骂？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Or you could try being a man for once and defending my honor. Up to you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}或者你可以试着当一次男人，为我的名誉辩护。随你。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Ugh...I’ll just get yelled at too. That’s easier...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}唉……我还是跟着挨骂吧。那个更容易……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}And just like that, Chinami is an only child.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}就这样，Chinami 变成独生女了。

lines.en: : But how’s she supposed to live on her own when she can’t even reach the freezer without a step stool?
lines.zh: : 可她连不踩小凳子都够不到冷冻柜，要怎么一个人生活啊？

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami26
: At least she can probably get Tsukasa to pay her bills. She’s even more desperate for companionship than Chinami is.
lines.zh: : 至少她大概能让 Tsukasa 替她付账单。她对陪伴的渴望，比 Chinami 还强烈。

lines.en: : {b}AHHHHH!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}啊啊啊啊！{/b}

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami27
: Ahhhhh!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: : {b}AHHHHHHHHHHHHH!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！{/b}

lines.en: : Ahhhhhh?!?!?!?
: {b}AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!!!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！！！！！！！{/b}

lines.en: : How long are we going to do this for?!?!?!
lines.zh: : 我们到底要这样叫多久？！？！？！

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami28
: DID YOU SEE THAT?!?!?! NIKI WAS INSIDE OUR HOME! SHE CALLED ME CUTE! OUR FACES WERE LIKE {i}THIS{/i} CLOSE! SHE SMELLED SO GOOD!
lines.zh: : 你看见了吗？！？！？！Niki 就在我们家里！她说我可爱！我们的脸离得就{i}那么{/i}近！她闻起来好香！

lines.en: : Ch...Chinami doesn’t remember how she smelled! But she’s glad big sis Chika is suddenly alive again!
lines.zh: : C……Chinami 不记得她闻起来是什么味道了！不过她很高兴 Chika 姐姐突然又活过来了！

lines.en: : {i}ALIVE?{/i} I’VE NEVER FELT THIS ALIVE IN MY LIFE! I COULD BE HIT BY A PLANE RIGHT NOW AND BE TOTALLY FINE!
lines.zh: : {i}活过来{/i}？我这辈子都没这么活过！就算现在被飞机撞了，我也完全没事！

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami29
: Chinami doesn’t understand one of the recurring themes in this event and wants to know when it will stop!
lines.zh: : Chinami 不明白这个事件里反复出现的一个主题，她想知道它到底什么时候才会停！

lines.en: : WE’VE BEEN BLESSED! THIS HOUSE HAS FELT THE TOUCH OF A GOD! NOTHING BAD WILL EVER HAPPEN TO US AGAIN! I DON’T EVEN {i}CARE{/i} THAT SHE’S STEALING MY MAN! I DESERVE IT! I CAN NOT COMPARE!
lines.zh: : 我们被赐福了！这栋房子感受到了神明的触碰！从今往后，再也不会有坏事发生在我们身上了！我甚至不{i}在乎{/i}她在抢我的男人！那是我活该！我根本比不上！

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami30
: Ch...Chinami doesn’t want big sis Chika talking that way about herself! Big sis Chika is pretty and amazing too! And Chinami think she’s just too excited to realize how sad she is right now...
lines.zh: : C……Chinami 不想听 Chika 姐姐这么说自己！Chika 姐姐也很漂亮、很了不起啊！而且 Chinami 觉得她只是太兴奋了，没意识到自己现在有多难过……

lines.en: : THE QUEEN TOLD ME I WAS {i}CUTE!{/i} I HAVE NO REASON TO EVER FEEL SADNESS AGAIN! I WISH SHE WAS STILL HERE SO I COULD CONSENT TO {i}EVERYTHING.{/i}
lines.zh: : 女王说我{i}可爱{/i}了！我再也没有任何理由感到悲伤了！我真希望她还在这儿，好让我同意{i}一切{/i}！

lines.en: : You’re...you’re kind of...scaring Chinami right now...
lines.zh: : 你……你现在有点……吓到 Chinami 了……

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami31
: Put your helmet on. We’re going to the mall.
lines.zh: : 戴上你的头盔。我们要去购物中心。

lines.en: : N...Now? But big sis Chika hasn’t eaten or taken a bath in almost twenty-four hours...And Chinami is hungry too. So-
lines.zh: : 现……现在？可 Chika 姐姐已经快二十四小时没吃东西、没洗澡了……而且 Chinami 也饿了。所以——

lines.en: : We can eat later! There are more pressing matters we must attend to! I have to buy every single thing Niki has ever been involved in! My love has multiplied tenfold! I MUST HAVE IT ALL! NO ONE BUT ME!
lines.zh: : 我们可以晚点再吃！还有更紧要的事情要办！我必须把 Niki 参与过的所有东西都买下来！我的爱翻了十倍！我全都要！除了我谁也不许有！

lines.en: : D...Do we even have the money for that?...
lines.zh: : 可……我们有那么多钱吗？……

lines.en: : I’ll steal it if I have to! Get {i}me{/i} a helmet too! To hide my identity! And where did you put my knife?! We might {i}need{/i} it!
lines.zh: : 必要的话我就去偷！也给{i}我{/i}拿个头盔！好遮住我的身份！还有，你把我的刀放哪儿了？！我们可能{i}需要{/i}它！

lines.en: scene nikivisitschinami32
: But Chinami literally just told everybody you weren’t a murderer!!!
lines.zh: : 可 Chinami 刚刚才跟大家说你不是杀人犯！！！

lines.en: scene black
: THAT WAS OLD CHIKA! I HAVE BEEN REBORN! THE WORLD WILL KNOW MY LOVE! NIKI WILL KNOW MY LOVE! EVEN IF EVERYONE ELSE ABANDONS HER!
lines.zh: : 那是旧的 Chika！我已经重生了！这个世界将会知晓我的爱！Niki 也会知晓我的爱！哪怕其他所有人都抛弃她！

lines.en: : CHINAMI IS STARTING TO THINK YOU WERE BETTER OFF AS A STATUE!!!
lines.zh: : CHINAMI 开始觉得你当个雕像的时候更好！！！
